stories.title: Reform UK's Farage faces off against Count Binface in election
stories.summary: Voters cast their ballots on Thursday in a local English election pitting Nigel Farage against his main challenger, a comedian dressed as a trash can, in a test of opposition ‌to the Reform UK leader's brand of populist politics. Our correspondent in London Benedicte Paviot tells us more.
stories.post: 📰 NEWS: Reform UK's Farage faces off against Count Binface in election. Voters cast their ballots on Thursday in a local English election pitting Nigel Farage against his main challenger, a comedian dressed as a trash can, in a test of opposition ‌to. Source: France 24.
